name: @v1hz/md2docx
description: 基于 pandoc 的 Markdown 转 Word 工具，自动格式化 Markdown，支持自定义样式，AI 友好，用户友好。
author: WXY-V1hZ

scripts.clean:dist: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: bun run clean:dist && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outdir dist --entry-naming index.js --asset-naming [name].[ext]
scripts.build:exe: bun run clean:dist && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile dist/md2docx.exe
scripts.check: bun tsc --noEmit && bun run oxlint && bun run oxfmt
scripts.build:electron: bun build --target=node --format=esm --outdir=dist-electron --asset-naming=[name].[ext] -e electron ./electron/main.ts && bun build --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs -e electron ./electron/preload.ts
scripts.electron: bun run build:electron && bun run build:frontend && electron .
scripts.pack: bun run build:electron && bun run build:frontend && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.pack:setup: bun run build:electron && bun run build:frontend && electron-builder --win nsis
